video.decoding_capability: Analog: 4 x 8MP Lite@8, 4 x 3K Lite@12, 4 x 5MP Lite@12 ...

features: Smart by XVR: Ultra Motion Detection (UMD), Face Detection, SIP (Intrusion Detection, Cross Line Detection, Enter Area, Leave Area)

Smart by IPC: Face Detection, SIP (Intrusion Detection, Cross Line Detection, Enter Area, Leave Area), Defocus Detection, Scene Change Detection, Auto Tracking, Object Left Behind, Object Removed, People Flow Counting
VCA search: Face Search, Behavior Search, People Counting Report
Recording resolution: 8MP Lite/3K Lite@12/5MP Lite/4MP Lite/1080P/720P/D1
notes: Datasheet lists 2 IP video inputs as standard and a maximum of 6.
Datasheet gives 40 Mbps incoming bandwidth, up to 48 Mbps after all analog channels are converted to IP.
